title: merchant.gateway_provisioned.v1
description: A gateway sub-account was provisioned for a merchant and the connection reached PROVISIONED. Published by Gateway Registry (BC-4) on pp.merchants.merchant.v1, keyed by merchant_id. Credentials are never carried - only the fact that a reference exists. The capabilities block is the RESOLVED INTERSECTION of what the gateway supports and what the merchant asked for, so a consumer does not have to recompute it.

gatewayCode.description: Stable gateway code, e.g. stripe, adyen, paypal.

environment.description: A SANDBOX provisioning never certifies a PRODUCTION connection.

externalAccountRef.description: The gateway's sub-account identifier. Provisioning is idempotent on this value, so a retry after an ambiguous failure adopts the existing sub-account instead of creating a second one.

credentialsStored.description: That a credential reference exists. NEVER the credentials themselves - the material lives only in the secrets manager under an IAM path scoped to (env, tenant, merchant, gateway).

resolvedCapabilities.title: Resolved capabilities
resolvedCapabilities.description: The intersection of the gateway's capability descriptor and the merchant's requested scope. Routing treats an absent capability as a hard exclusion, never as 'probably fine'.
